@@ -2,28 +2,27 @@
 
 Latest Bloxd build per environment, detected by the external Cloudflare Worker in `cloudflare/` (one poll per minute). GitHub Actions is dispatched only when a bundle changes; its built-in schedule is a six-hour fallback.
 Every bundle is beautified and archived under stable logical paths: main.js, main.css, chunks/js/<chunk-id-or-name>.js, and matching CSS paths. Original CDN file names, URLs, and hashes are retained in .monitor-state.json.
-This keeps each Webpack chunk on the same Git path across builds, so GitHub shows a normal file modification instead of delete/add. Every detected build is saved as a new ordinary commit. The current files on `main` show the latest build, while every previous snapshot remains accessible through Git history. Build history is never squashed or force-pushed.

+.StudioPage {

+}
+

+  background-color: #394980;

+

+}
+
+.MiddleScreenPopupBackground .MiddleScreenPopup.SchematicPopup .SchematicPopupTitle {
+  font-size: 2.5rem;
+  font-weight: 700;
+  margin: 0
+}
+
+.MiddleScreenPopupBackground .MiddleScreenPopup.SchematicPopup .SchematicPopupSubtitle {

+}
+
+.MiddleScreenPopupBackground .MiddleScreenPopup.SchematicPopup .SchematicPopupSubtitle.Hidden {
+  display: none
+}
+
+.MiddleScreenPopupBackground .MiddleScreenPopup.SchematicPopup .SchematicPopupSchematicListContainer {
+  border: 2px solid #303a59;
+  border-radius: 0;
+  box-sizing: border-box;
+  overflow-y: auto;

+}
+
+.SchematicImageContainer {

+
+.SchematicImageContainer .LogoLoaderOuter {
+  border-color: #a4a4a4 #f2f2f2 #f2f2f2
+}
+
+.SchematicImageContainer .SchematicImage {
+  background-position: 50%;
+  background-repeat: no-repeat;
+  background-size: cover;
+  height: 100%;
+  left: 0;
+  position: absolute;
+  top: 0;
+  width: 100%
+}
+
+.SchematicImageContainer .SchematicImage.SchematicImageFadeIn {
+  animation-duration: .3s;
+  animation-fill-mode: backwards;
+  animation-iteration-count: 1;
+  animation-name: fadeIn;
+  isolation: isolate
+}
+
+.SchematicImageContainer .SchematicImageError {
+  color: #cfcfcf;
+  opacity: .4
+}
+
+.Table {
+  border-collapse: collapse;
+  width: 100%
+}
+
+@keyframes rainbowShimmer {
+  0% {
+    transform: translateX(0)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    transform: translateX(88.88889%)
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes rainbowShimmerPosition {
+  to {
+    background-position: -200% 0
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes fadeIn {
+  0% {
+    opacity: 0
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: 1
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes fadeInScaleUp {
+  0% {
+    opacity: 0;
+    transform: scale(.6)
+  }
+
+  50% {
+    opacity: 1;
+    transform: scale(1.1)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: 1;
+    transform: scale(1)
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes fadeInScaleUpNoOversize {
+  0% {
+    opacity: 0;
+    transform: scale(.8)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: 1;
+    transform: scale(1)
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes shake {
+  0% {
+    rotate: 3deg
+  }
+
+  5% {
+    rotate: -2deg
+  }
+
+  10% {
+    rotate: 2deg
+  }
+
+  15% {
+    rotate: -3deg
+  }
+
+  20% {
+    rotate: 0deg
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes loadingShimmer {
+  0% {
+    transform: translateX(-66.6666666667%)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    transform: none
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes topRightStackIn {

+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: 1;
+    transform: translateX(0)
+  }
+}
+
+.StudioTable {

+
+.StudioTable tbody tr.pad-focused {

+

+}
+
+.StudioTable tbody tr td {

+}
+
+.StudioTable .StudioTableGameCell {
+  align-items: center;
+  display: flex;
+  gap: .75rem
+}
+

+

+  --joystick-y: clamp(var(--joystick-radius), 100vh - 100px - var(--preview-joystick-shift-bottom, 0px) + var(--hud-joystick-dy, 0) * 100vh, 100vh - var(--joystick-radius));
+  height: calc(var(--joystick-radius)*2);

+.SkyblockReachLogPanel .SkyblockReachLogDepths {
+  --island-glow: #3ce1c3;
+  background: radial-gradient(ellipse 90% 40% at 50% 105%, rgba(60, 225, 195, .16), transparent), radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 35% at 15% 0, rgba(195, 125, 255, .14), transparent);
+  contain: strict;
+  inset: 0;
+  pointer-events: none;
+  position: absolute;
+  z-index: -1
+}
+
+.SkyblockReachLogPanel .SkyblockReachLogDepths.Island-harbour {
+  --island-glow: #3ce1c3
+}
+
+.SkyblockReachLogPanel .SkyblockReachLogDepths.Island-lamp {
+  --island-glow: #ffd778
+}
+
+.SkyblockReachLogPanel .SkyblockReachLogDepths.Island-kelpwood {
+  --island-glow: #6ef082
+}
+
+.SkyblockReachLogPanel .SkyblockReachLogDepths.Island-amethyst {
+  --island-glow: #c37dff
+}
+
+.SkyblockReachLogPanel .SkyblockReachLogDepths.Island-moonwell {
+  --island-glow: #5587ff
+}
+
+.SkyblockReachLogPanel .SkyblockReachLogShaft {
+  animation: SkyblockReachLogShaft var(--duration) ease-in-out var(--delay) infinite alternate;
+  background: radial-gradient(ellipse 50% 100% at 50% 0, rgba(60, 225, 195, .16), transparent);
+  height: 120%;
+  left: var(--left);
+  opacity: .6;
+  position: absolute;
+  top: -10%;
+  transform: rotate(var(--tilt));
+  transform-origin: 50% 0;
+  width: 8rem
+}
+
+.SkyblockReachLogPanel .SkyblockReachLogMote {
+  animation: SkyblockReachLogMote var(--duration) ease-in-out var(--delay) infinite alternate;
+  background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--island-glow), transparent 70%);
+  height: var(--size);
+  left: var(--x);
+  opacity: .12;
+  position: absolute;
+  top: var(--y);
+  width: var(--size)
+}
+
+.SkyblockReachLogPanel .SkyblockReachLogMote.Violet {
+  background: radial-gradient(circle, #c37dff, transparent 70%)
+}
+
+.SkyblockReachLogPanel .SkyblockReachLogBubble {
+  animation: SkyblockReachLogBubbleRise var(--duration) linear var(--delay) infinite, SkyblockReachLogBubbleSway calc(var(--duration)/4) ease-in-out var(--delay) infinite alternate;
+  height: 100%;
+  left: var(--left);
+  opacity: 0;
+  position: absolute;
+  top: 100%;
+  width: var(--size)
+}
+
+.SkyblockReachLogPanel .SkyblockReachLogBubble:before {
+  background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%, rgba(205, 222, 240, .8) 0 20%, rgba(60, 225, 195, .2) 45%, transparent 70%);
+  border: 1px solid rgba(60, 225, 195, .75);
+  border-radius: 50%;
+  box-sizing: border-box;
+  content: "";
+  height: var(--size);
+  left: 0;
+  position: absolute;
+  top: 0;
+  width: var(--size)
+}
+
+@keyframes SkyblockReachLogShaft {
+  0% {
+    opacity: .35;
+    transform: rotate(calc(var(--tilt) - 4deg))
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: 1;
+    transform: rotate(calc(var(--tilt) + 4deg))
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes SkyblockReachLogMote {
+  0% {
+    opacity: .08;
+    transform: translateZ(0) scale(.85)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: .3;
+    transform: translate3d(var(--drift-x), var(--drift-y), 0) scale(1.1)
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes SkyblockReachLogBubbleRise {
+  0% {
+    opacity: 0;
+    transform: translateZ(0)
+  }
+
+  10% {
+    opacity: 1
+  }
+
+  80% {
+    opacity: .8
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: 0;
+    transform: translate3d(0, -100%, 0)
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes SkyblockReachLogBubbleSway {
+  0% {
+    translate: calc(var(--sway)*-1) 0
+  }
+
+  to {
+    translate: var(--sway) 0
+  }
+}
+
+@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) {
+
+  .SkyblockReachLogPanel .SkyblockReachLogMote,
+  .SkyblockReachLogPanel .SkyblockReachLogShaft {
+    animation: none
+  }
+
+  .SkyblockReachLogPanel .SkyblockReachLogBubble {
+    display: none
+  }
+}
+

+  .Baf2TermBody {

+.NxLane {

+  min-height: 0;
+  min-width: 0;
+  overflow: hidden;
+  padding: .5rem .6rem .6rem;
+  position: relative;
+  text-align: left
+}
+
+.NxLane.Fuel {
+  border-left-color: #b6ff3b
+}
+
+.NxLane.Water {
+  border-left-color: #3fd0f0
+}
+
+.NxLane.Cryo {
+  border-left-color: #a8f0ff
+}
+
+.NxLane.Power {
+  border-left-color: #f2c94c
+}
+
+.NxLane.Waste {
+  border-left-color: #d9a73a
+}
+
+.NxLane.Store {

+}

+@media(hover:hover) {

+    background: #394980
+  }
+}
+
+.NxLane.pad-focused {
+  background: #394980
+}
+
+@media(hover:none) {
+  .NxLane:active {
+    background: #394980
+  }
+}
+
+.NxLane.Warn {
+  border-color: #ffb914
+}
+
+.NxLane.Warn .NxLaneNote {
+  color: #fcd373
+}
+
+.NxLane.Danger {
+  border-color: #fc6464
+}
+
+.NxLane.Danger .NxLaneNote {
+  color: #ff8a80
+}
+
+.NxLane .NxLaneFill.Fuel {
+  background: #b6ff3b
+}
+
+.NxLane .NxLaneFill.Water {
+  background: #3fd0f0
+}
+
+.NxLane .NxLaneFill.Cryo {
+  background: #a8f0ff
+}
+
+.NxLane .NxLaneFill.Power {
+  background: #f2c94c
+}
+
+.NxLane .NxLaneFill.Waste {
+  background: #d9a73a
+}
+
+.NxLane .NxLaneFill.Store {
+  background: #f2c94c
+}
+
+.NxLaneHead {
+  align-items: center;
+  color: #a4a4a4;
+  display: flex;
+  font-size: max(.9rem, 10px);
+  gap: .35rem;
+  min-width: 0
+}
+
+.NxLaneHead .Baf2PanelIcon {
+  flex-shrink: 0;
+  height: max(1.4rem, 14px);
+  width: max(1.4rem, 14px)
+}
+
+.NxLaneLabel,
+.NxLaneNum {
+  overflow: hidden;
+  text-overflow: ellipsis;
+  white-space: nowrap
+}
+
+.NxLaneNum {
+  font-feature-settings: "tnum";
+  font-size: max(1.5rem, 14px);
+  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
+  font-weight: 700
+}
+
+.NxLanePreview {
+  font-size: .7em;
+  opacity: .7
+}
+
+.NxLaneNote {
+  color: #f2f2f2;
+  font-size: max(.85rem, 10px);
+  overflow-wrap: anywhere
+}
+
+.NxLaneFill {
+  bottom: 0;
+  height: 3px;
+  left: 0;
+  position: absolute;
+  transition: width .9s linear
+}
+
+.NxPipe {
+  align-self: center;
+  background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, currentColor 0 6px, transparent 6px 10px);
+  background-size: 10px 3px;
+  color: #838383;
+  display: block;
+  height: 3px;
+  margin-right: 5px;
+  position: relative
+}
+
+.NxPipe.Fuel {
+  color: #b6ff3b
+}
+
+.NxPipe.Water {
+  color: #3fd0f0
+}
+
+.NxPipe.Cryo {
+  color: #a8f0ff
+}
+
+.NxPipe.Power {
+  color: #f2c94c
+}
+
+.NxPipe.Waste {
+  color: #d9a73a
+}
+
+.NxPipe.Store {
+  color: #f2c94c
+}
+
+.NxPipe:after {
+  border: 4.5px solid transparent;
+  border-left: 5px solid;
+  border-right: 0;
+  content: "";
+  position: absolute;
+  right: -5px;
+  top: -3px
+}
+
+.NxPipe.Planned,
+.NxPipe.Step0 {
+  color: #838383
+}
+
+.NxPipe.Short {
+  color: #ffb914
+}
+
+.NxPipe.Short:before {
+  color: #fcd373;
+  content: "!";
+  font-size: 10px;
+  font-weight: 700;
+  left: 50%;
+  position: absolute;
+  top: -1.1em;
+  transform: translateX(-50%)
+}
+
+.NxPipe.Step1 {
+  animation: NxPipeFlow 1.6s linear infinite
+}
+
+.NxPipe.Step2 {
+  animation: NxPipeFlow .8s linear infinite
+}
+
+.NxPipe.Step3 {
+  animation: NxPipeFlow .45s linear infinite
+}
+
+.NxPipe.Step4 {
+  animation: NxPipeFlow .25s linear infinite
+}
+
+.NxPipe.Planned {
+  animation: none
+}
+
+@keyframes NxPipeFlow {
+  0% {
+    background-position: 0 0
+  }
+
+  to {
+    background-position: 10px 0
+  }
+}
+
+.NxGauge {
+  background: none;
+  border: 0;
+  color: inherit;
+  cursor: pointer;
+  display: flex;
+  font: inherit;
+  gap: 3px;
+  min-height: 0;
+  padding: 0
+}
+
+.NxGauge,
+.NxGaugeTrack {
+  height: 100%;
+  position: relative
+}
+
+.NxGaugeTrack {
+  background: #1a1f2e;
+  overflow: visible;
+  width: max(.9rem, 10px)
+}
+
+.NxGaugeBand {
+  left: 0;
+  opacity: .85;
+  position: absolute;
+  right: 0
+}
+
+.NxGaugeBand.cold {
+  background: #5aa9ff
+}
+
+.NxGaugeBand.warm {
+  background: #ffb020
+}
+
+.NxGaugeBand.hot {
+  background: #ff7a2b
+}
+
+.NxGaugeBand.red {
+  background: #ff3b30
+}
+
+.NxGaugeBand.Store {
+  background: #f2c94c
+}
+
+.NxGaugeBand.Empty {
+  background: #1a1f2e
+}
+
+.NxGaugeNow,
+.NxGaugeSettle {
+  height: 4px;
+  left: -3px;
+  margin-bottom: -2px;
+  position: absolute;
+  right: -3px;
+  transition: bottom .9s linear
+}
+
+.NxGaugeNow {
+  background: #fff;
+  border: 1px solid #000
+}
+
+.NxGaugeSettle {
+  border: 5px solid transparent;
+  border-left: 0;
+  border-right: 7px solid #fff;
+  height: 0;
+  left: auto;
+  margin-bottom: -5px;
+  right: -7px;
+  transition: none;
+  width: 0
+}
+
+.NxGaugeSettle.Bad {
+  border-right-color: #ff3b30
+}
+
+.NxGaugeTicks {
+  height: 100%;
+  position: relative;
+  width: max(1.6rem, 16px)
+}
+
+.NxGaugeTicks small {
+  color: #a4a4a4;
+  font-size: max(.75rem, 9px);
+  left: 6px;
+  line-height: 1;
+  position: absolute;
+  transform: translateY(50%)
+}
+
+.NxStatus {
+  -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
+  -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
+  color: #f2f2f2;
+  display: -webkit-box;
+  font-size: max(.95rem, 10px);
+  line-height: 1.3;
+  margin: 0;
+  min-height: 2.6em;
+  overflow: hidden
+}
+
+.NxStatus.bad {
+  color: #ff8a80
+}
+
+.NxStatus.warn {
+  color: #fcd373
+}
+
+.NxStatus.ok {
+  color: #1dd06d
+}
+
+.NxStatus.Explain {
+  color: #85baff
+}
+
+.NxStatusWhy {
+  background: #85baff;
+  border-radius: 50%;
+  color: #22283b;
+  display: inline-block;
+  margin-right: .35em;
+  min-width: 1.2em;
+  text-align: center
+}
+
+@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) {
+  .NxPipe {
+    animation: none !important
+  }
+
+  .NxGaugeNow,
+  .NxLaneFill {
+    transition: none
+  }
+}

+.Baf2RxSwitch .Baf2RxKnob {

+}

+.Baf2RxSwitch .Baf2RxKnob:after {

+  content: "";
+  height: calc(max(1.4rem, 14px) - 4px);
+  left: 2px;
+  position: absolute;
+  top: 2px;
+  transition: transform .15s;

+}

+.Baf2RxSwitch.Pending .Baf2RxKnob {

+.Baf2RxSwitch.On .Baf2RxKnob:after {

+.rangeslider {

+  border-radius: 0;
+  margin: 20px 0;
+  position: relative;
+  touch-action: none
+}
+
+.rangeslider,
+.rangeslider .rangeslider__fill {
+  border-radius: 0;
+  box-shadow: inset 0 1px 3px rgba(0, 0, 0, .4);
+  display: block
+}
+
+.rangeslider .rangeslider__handle {
+  background: #f2f2f2;
+  border: 1px solid #0f0f0f;
+  border-radius: 0;
+  box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0, 0, 0, .4), 0 -1px 3px rgba(0, 0, 0, .4);
+  cursor: pointer;
+  display: inline-block;
+  position: absolute
+}
+
+@media(pointer:coarse) {
+  .rangeslider .rangeslider__handle:before {
+    content: "";
+    inset: min(0px, (100% - 44px)/2) min(0px, (100% - 44px)/2);
+    position: absolute
+  }
+}
+
+.rangeslider .rangeslider__handle .rangeslider__active {
+  opacity: 1
+}
+
+.rangeslider .rangeslider__handle-tooltip {
+  background-color: #394980;
+  color: #fff;
+  display: inline-block;
+  font-size: 14px;
+  font-weight: 400;
+  height: 40px;
+  left: 50%;
+  position: absolute;
+  text-align: center;
+  transform: translate3d(-50%, 0, 0);
+  width: 40px
+}
+
+.rangeslider .rangeslider__handle-tooltip span {
+  display: inline-block;
+  line-height: 100%;
+  margin-top: 12px
+}
+
+.rangeslider .rangeslider__handle-tooltip:after {
+  content: " ";
+  height: 0;
+  position: absolute;
+  width: 0
+}
+
+.rangeslider-horizontal {
+  height: 12px
+}
+
+.rangeslider-horizontal .rangeslider__fill {
+  background-color: #2e80ee;
+  height: 100%;
+  top: 0
+}
+
+.rangeslider-horizontal .rangeslider__handle {
+  height: 30px;
+  top: 50%;
+  transform: translate3d(-50%, -50%, 0);
+  width: 30px
+}
+
+.rangeslider-horizontal .rangeslider__handle:after {
+  background-color: #cfcfcf;
+  box-shadow: inset 0 1px 3px rgba(0, 0, 0, .4), inset 0 -1px 3px rgba(0, 0, 0, .4);
+  content: " ";
+  height: 16px;
+  left: 50%;
+  position: absolute;
+  top: 50%;
+  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
+  width: 16px
+}
+
+.rangeslider-horizontal .rangeslider__handle-tooltip {
+  top: -55px
+}
+
+.rangeslider-horizontal .rangeslider__handle-tooltip:after {
+  border-left: 8px solid transparent;
+  border-right: 8px solid transparent;
+  border-top: 8px solid #394980;
+  bottom: -8px;
+  left: 50%;
+  transform: translate3d(-50%, 0, 0)
+}
+
+.rangeslider-vertical {
+  background-color: transparent;
+  height: 150px;
+  margin: 20px auto;
+  max-width: 10px
+}
+
+.rangeslider-vertical .rangeslider__fill,
+.rangeslider-vertical .rangeslider__handle {
+  position: absolute
+}
+
+.rangeslider-vertical .rangeslider__fill {
+  background-color: #2e80ee;
+  bottom: 0;
+  box-shadow: none;
+  width: 100%
+}
+
+.rangeslider-vertical .rangeslider__handle {
+  box-shadow: none;
+  height: 10px;
+  left: -10px;
+  width: 30px
+}
+
+.rangeslider-vertical .rangeslider__handle-tooltip {
+  left: -100%;
+  top: 50%;
+  transform: translate3d(-50%, -50%, 0)
+}
+
+.rangeslider-vertical .rangeslider__handle-tooltip:after {
+  border-bottom: 8px solid transparent;
+  border-left: 8px solid #394980;
+  border-top: 8px solid transparent;
+  left: 100%;
+  top: 12px
+}
+
+.rangeslider-reverse.rangeslider-horizontal .rangeslider__fill {
+  right: 0
+}
+
+.rangeslider-reverse.rangeslider-vertical .rangeslider__fill {
+  bottom: inherit;
+  top: 0
+}
+
+.rangeslider__labels {
+  position: relative
+}
+
+.rangeslider-vertical .rangeslider__labels {
+  height: 100%;
+  left: 10px;

+@keyframes HelperSlideKeyFrame {
+  0% {
+    transform: translateY(calc(-100% - 30px))
+  }
+
+  33% {
+    transform: translateY(0)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    transform: translateY(0)
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes HelperSlideKeyFrameReverse {
+  0% {
+    transform: translateY(0)
+  }
+
+  66% {
+    transform: translateY(0)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    transform: translateY(calc(-100% - 30px))
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes ExpandNotification {
+  0% {
+    transform: scaleX(.05)
+  }
+
+  33% {
+    transform: scaleX(.05)
+  }
+
+  66% {
+    transform: scaleX(1)
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes CloseNotification {
+  0% {
+    transform: scaleX(1)
+  }
+
+  33% {
+    transform: scaleX(1)
+  }
+
+  66% {
+    transform: scaleX(1)
+  }
+}

+  }

+  }

+  }
+
+  to {

+  }

+.ResizableSidePanel {
+  --handleWidth: 0.7rem;
+  box-sizing: border-box;
+  display: flex;
+  flex-shrink: 1;
+  min-height: 0;
+  min-width: 8rem;
+  position: relative
+}
+
+@media(pointer:coarse) {
+  .ResizableSidePanel {
+    --handleWidth: 1.2rem
+  }
+}
+
+.ResizableSidePanel>:first-child {
+  flex: 1 1;
+  min-width: 0
+}
+
+.ResizableSidePanel.ResizableSidePanel-left {
+  border-right: 2px solid #22283b
+}
+
+.ResizableSidePanel.ResizableSidePanel-left .ResizableSidePanelHandle {
+  right: -2px
+}
+
+.ResizableSidePanel.ResizableSidePanel-left .ResizableSidePanelHandle:after {
+  left: auto;
+  right: 0;
+  transform: none
+}
+
+.ResizableSidePanel.ResizableSidePanel-right {
+  border-left: 2px solid #22283b
+}
+
+.ResizableSidePanel.ResizableSidePanel-right .ResizableSidePanelHandle {
+  left: -2px
+}
+
+.ResizableSidePanel.ResizableSidePanel-right .ResizableSidePanelHandle:after {
+  left: 0;
+  transform: none
+}
+
+.ResizableSidePanel.ResizableSidePanel-top {
+  border-bottom: 2px solid #22283b;
+  min-width: 0
+}
+
+.ResizableSidePanel.ResizableSidePanel-top .ResizableSidePanelHandle {
+  bottom: -2px;
+  cursor: row-resize;
+  height: var(--handleWidth);
+  left: 0;
+  right: 0;
+  top: auto;
+  width: auto
+}
+
+.ResizableSidePanel.ResizableSidePanel-top .ResizableSidePanelHandle:after {
+  bottom: 0;
+  height: 2px;
+  left: 0;
+  right: 0;
+  top: auto;
+  transform: none;
+  width: auto
+}
+
+.ResizableSidePanel.ResizableSidePanel-top .ResizableSidePanelHandle:before {
+  background-color: #a6adc8;
+  bottom: 1px;
+  content: "";
+  height: .35rem;
+  left: 50%;
+  position: absolute;
+  transform: translate(-50%, 50%);
+  transition: background-color .15s;
+  width: 3rem
+}
+
+.ResizableSidePanel.ResizableSidePanel-top .ResizableSidePanelHandle:active:before {
+  background-color: #89b4fa
+}
+
+@media(hover:hover) {

+    background-color: #89b4fa
+  }
+}
+
+.ResizableSidePanel.ResizableSidePanel-top .ResizableSidePanelHandle.pad-focused:before {
+  background-color: #89b4fa
+}
+
+@media(hover:none) {
+  .ResizableSidePanel.ResizableSidePanel-top .ResizableSidePanelHandle:active:before {
+    background-color: #89b4fa
+  }
+}
+
+.ResizableSidePanel.Covers {

+.ResizableSidePanel.Covers .ResizableSidePanelHandle {

+@media(max-width:900px) {

+@keyframes rainbowShimmer {
+  0% {
+    transform: translateX(0)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    transform: translateX(88.88889%)
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes rainbowShimmerPosition {
+  to {
+    background-position: -200% 0
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes fadeIn {
+  0% {
+    opacity: 0
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: 1
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes fadeInScaleUp {
+  0% {
+    opacity: 0;
+    transform: scale(.6)
+  }
+
+  50% {
+    opacity: 1;
+    transform: scale(1.1)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: 1;
+    transform: scale(1)
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes fadeInScaleUpNoOversize {
+  0% {
+    opacity: 0;
+    transform: scale(.8)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: 1;
+    transform: scale(1)
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes shake {
+  0% {
+    rotate: 3deg
+  }
+
+  5% {
+    rotate: -2deg
+  }
+
+  10% {
+    rotate: 2deg
+  }
+
+  15% {
+    rotate: -3deg
+  }
+
+  20% {
+    rotate: 0deg
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes loadingShimmer {
+  0% {
+    transform: translateX(-66.6666666667%)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    transform: none
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes topRightStackIn {
+  0% {
+    opacity: 0;
+    transform: translateX(1.5rem)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: 1;
+    transform: translateX(0)
+  }
+}

+@keyframes BoardMugshotGlitch {
+  0% {
+    filter: none;
+    transform: none
+  }
+
+  88% {
+    filter: contrast(1.8);
+    transform: translateX(.05em)
+  }
+
+  90% {
+    filter: brightness(1.4);
+    transform: translateX(-.08em) skewX(6deg)
+  }
+
+  92% {
+    filter: none;
+    transform: none
+  }
+
+  96% {
+    filter: invert(1);
+    transform: translateY(.04em)
+  }
+
+  97% {
+    filter: none;
+    transform: none
+  }
+}

+@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) {
+
+  .FrontlineRoundEnd .FrontlineRoundEndMvps .FrontlineMvpCard,

+  }

+@keyframes FrontlineRoundEndFadeIn {
+  0% {
+    opacity: 0
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: 1
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes FrontlineRoundEndFadeUp {
+  0% {
+    opacity: 0;
+    transform: translateY(.75rem)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: 1;
+    transform: none
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes FrontlineRoundEndScan {
+  0% {
+    opacity: 1;
+    transform: none
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: .4;
+    transform: translateY(100vh)
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes FrontlineRoundEndRise {
+  to {
+    transform: translateY(-34vh) scale(.55)
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes FrontlineRoundEndSweep {
+  to {
+    transform: scaleX(1)
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes FrontlineRoundEndLockOn {
+  0% {
+    opacity: 0;
+    transform: translate(calc(var(--out)*2.5rem), calc(var(--out)*2.5rem))
+  }
+
+  40% {
+    opacity: 1
+  }
+
+  55% {
+    opacity: .2
+  }
+
+  70% {
+    opacity: 1
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: 1;
+    transform: none
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes FrontlineRoundEndLetterIn {
+  0% {
+    color: #fff;
+    opacity: 0;
+    transform: translateX(-.25em)
+  }
+
+  15% {
+    opacity: 1
+  }
+
+  25% {
+    opacity: 0
+  }
+
+  40% {
+    opacity: 1;
+    transform: translateX(.05em)
+  }
+
+  55% {
+    opacity: .4
+  }
+
+  70% {
+    color: #fff;
+    opacity: 1;
+    transform: none
+  }
+
+  to {
+    color: var(--resultColour);
+    opacity: 1;
+    transform: none
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes FrontlineMvpCardIn {
+  0% {
+    clip-path: polygon(0 0, 0 0, 0 calc(100% - .875rem), 0 100%, 0 100%, 0 .875rem);
+    filter: brightness(2.5)
+  }
+}

+@media(pointer:coarse) {

+  }

+.rangeslider-horizontal .rangeslider__handle:after {

+  top: 50%;

+.rangeslider-horizontal .rangeslider__handle-tooltip {

+}
+
+.rangeslider-horizontal .rangeslider__handle-tooltip:after {

+  left: 50%;

+

+

+}
+
+.rangeslider-vertical .rangeslider__handle-tooltip {

+
+.rangeslider-vertical .rangeslider__handle-tooltip:after {

+  border: 1px solid #0f0f0f;
+  border-radius: 0;
+  color: #cfcfcf;
+  display: flex;
+  flex-direction: column;
+  gap: .2em;
+  padding: 1.6em 1em;
+  text-align: center
+}
+
+.SmpEmpty b {
+  color: #fff
+}
+
+@container smpshop (max-width: 36em) {
+  .SmpHeader {
+    padding: calc(.6em + var(--notchTop)) calc(7rem + .5em) .6em .9em
+  }
+
+  .SmpHeaderTitle h2 {
+    font-size: 1.2em
+  }
+
+  .SmpHeaderTitle p {
+    display: none
+  }
+
+  .SmpScreen {
+    padding: .7em .7em 1.2em
+  }
+
+  .SmpListingRow {
+    grid-template: "slot text text" auto "slot price buy" auto/3.1em minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
+    row-gap: .3em
+  }
+
+  .SmpListingRow .SmpSlot {
+    grid-area: slot
+  }
+
+  .SmpListingRow .SmpRowText {
+    grid-area: text
+  }
+
+  .SmpListingRow .SmpRowPrice {
+    grid-area: price;
+    justify-content: flex-start
+  }
+
+  .SmpListingRow .SmpBuyButton {
+    grid-area: buy;
+    min-width: 0
+  }
+
+  .SmpRowText b,
+  .SmpRowText small {
+    overflow-wrap: anywhere;
+    white-space: normal
+  }
+
+  .SmpColumns {
+    display: none
+  }
+
+  .SmpItemHeader {
+    gap: .5em
+  }
+
+  .SmpItemHeader .SmpSlot-big {
+    height: 3.1em;
+    width: 3.1em
+  }
+
+  .SmpItemHeaderText b {
+    font-size: 1.1em
+  }
+
+  .SmpRowText small.SmpListingFacts {
+    flex-direction: column
+  }
+
+  .SmpRowText small.SmpListingFacts>span+span:before {
+    content: none
+  }
+
+  .SmpCardGrid {
+    gap: .4em;
+    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(8em, 1fr))
+  }
+
+  .SmpRow {
+    flex-wrap: wrap
+  }
+
+  .SmpOrderRow .SmpChoice {
+    flex: 1 1
+  }
+
+  .SmpFormGrid {
+    grid-template-columns: 1fr
+  }
+}
+
+@media(max-height:500px)and (orientation:landscape) {
+  .SmpHeaderTitle p {
+    display: none
+  }
+
+  .SmpHeader {
+    padding: calc(.4em + var(--notchTop)) max(7rem + .5em, max(1em, (100% - 48em)/2 + 1em)) .4em max(1em, (100% - 48em)/2 + 1em)
+  }
+
+  .SmpHeaderTitle h2 {
+    font-size: 1.25em
+  }
+
+  .SmpScreen {
+    padding: .7em .8em 1em
+  }
+}
+
+@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) {
+  .SmpShop * {
+    animation: none !important;
+    transition: none !important
+  }
+}

+@keyframes storeSearchPulse {
+
+  0%,
+  to {
+    box-shadow: 0 0 0 .3rem rgba(243, 138, 182, .25)
+  }
+
+  50% {
+    box-shadow: 0 0 0 .7rem rgba(243, 138, 182, .45)
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes storeCtaHighlight {
+
+  0%,
+  to {
+    filter: none;
+    transform: scale(1)
+  }
+
+  50% {
+    filter: drop-shadow(0 0 .8rem rgba(255, 214, 102, .9));
+    transform: scale(1.08)
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes storeNoticePop {
+  0% {
+    opacity: 0;
+    transform: scale(.9)
+  }
+
+  60% {
+    opacity: 1;
+    transform: scale(1.03)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    transform: scale(1)
+  }
+}
